query:
SELECT p.id AS "user_id!", p.email AS "email!"
           FROM auth.people p
           WHERE p.id = ANY($1) AND p.email IS NOT NULL
             AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teaching.effective_members m
                         WHERE m.user_id = p.id AND ($2::uuid[] IS NULL OR m.course_id = ANY($2)))
           ORDER BY p.id
